subject: SIG: scope and evidence for GDPR/SCCs & HIPAA feasibility — hybrid deployments
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@medtechinc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedTech Procurement <procurement@medtechinc.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: GDPR/SCCs + HIPAA feasibility for hybrid setup

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team appreciated the performance numbers. We reviewed the SIG spreadsheet you sent and have a few follow-ups specifically around privacy/regulatory scope. High level: MedTech is evaluating a hybrid deployment (hosted API for non-PHI telemetry; private VPC for PHI workflows). We need to confirm the following before moving to procurement: 

- Which specific SCC pathway Redwood relies on today (EU Standard Contractual Clauses 2010 vs. 2021; or adequacy+controller-to-processor addendum)?
- Is there an existing DPA template we can review that includes SCC mapping?
- For HIPAA/BAA: is Redwood able to sign a BAA for customer-managed private deployments, and if so what controls/evidence are required for our legal team?
- Evidence: can you provide SOC 2 Type II report excerpt (security/availability controls) and the specific artifacts you expect us to review for HIPAA feasibility (e.g., KMS configuration, network isolation diagram)?

I've attached an annotated SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx with inline comments. Can you confirm which items you can answer now and which need internal review? Ideally we'd get the initial answers + evidence within 5 business days so procurement can open the SOW thread.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Torres
Head of IT Risk & Privacy
MedTech Inc.
elena.torres@medtechinc.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: GDPR/SCCs + HIPAA feasibility for hybrid setup

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the annotated SIG. Attaching a first-pass PDF with answers for the questionnaire items we can confirm today (SIG_partial_answers.pdf). Quick summary: 

- SCCs: Redwood relies on the 2021 EU SCCs with a processor-to-processor annex when acting as processor; we include the SCC addendum in our DPA. I'll attach the SCC annex statement and a short mapping in the follow-up package.
- DPA: we have a standard DPA that includes SCC references and data processing terms; procurement/legal can review it.
- HIPAA/BAA: for our hosted PROD API we do not accept PHI under our shared-tenant offering. For Dedicated or Private VPC deployments we have a path to sign a BAA; we require an operational readiness checklist (network isolation, customer-managed keys or approved KMS patterns, logging/audit retention). We need to validate your expected deployment topology against that checklist.
- Evidence: we can share redacted SOC 2 Type II (security and availability) and network isolation diagrams for Private deployments. Some artifacts (e.g., internal runbooks) require an NDA/secure link; we'll provide those via your CISO/secure share.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I'll loop in legal and infra (cc'ed) to validate SCC language and HIPAA ops checklist.
2) Please confirm which data categories you expect to process in Private vs Hosted (PHI vs telemetry). That determines the evidence set.
3) If convenient, let's schedule a 30-minute call mid next week to walk the checklist and agree on timeline.

Ben

- SCCs / DPA: Laura, can you confirm the exact SCC template we rely on and whether the 2021 modular clauses are fully supported? Also, any redlines we should anticipate from MedTech legal?
- HIPAA/BAA: Vivek, operationally can we meet the checklist for Private VPC deployments where the customer requests a BAA? Items to confirm: customer-managed KMS or HSM support, encrypted egress, dedicated subnets, log retention (1 year vs 7 years), and penetration test cadence.
- Evidence package: Neha, please pull the redacted SOC2-Audit-Report-2024.pdf excerpt (security & availability sections) and the SCC-Annex-Statement. Also add the network isolation diagram and KMS configuration excerpt. We'll ship via secure Drive link.

Elena asked for a 5 business day turnaround — we should aim for EOD today for the initial package (answers + list of evidence) and then schedule the call.
